finish_summary: 1. `parse_coupon` only accepts values 1-50; test for 5 fails (ValueError). 2. `bulk_discount_percent(50)` should return 10 per spec, but returns 5. 3. `Cart.remove_item` does not raise KeyError when removing more units than present; it silently deletes the item if quantity becomes negative. This differs from expected behavior of raising an error for invalid removal.
